responsibility: Build-system make fragment for the C++ front end. It tells the top-level GCC build how to compile and link cc1plus and the g++ driver, which C++ source objects and plugin headers belong to the language, how generated artifacts such as module version stamps, checksums, gperf-produced headers, and selftest targets are created, and how C++-specific install, clean, stage, and testsuite hooks are wired into the global build.
